card.name: Inside 'disintegrated' and linking words
card.fires_on: Mainly the 'int' piece inside 'disintegrated' in instructions for dispersing a tablet in an oral syringe. Also weaker on small linking words such as 'where' after substrates or 'in' before a percentage.

modes.label: Inside disintegrated
modes.description: The 'int' piece partway through 'disintegrated' when checking that a tablet has dissolved.
modes.example: Do not administer unless the tablet has fully dis<<int>>egrated.

modes.label: Linking word after substrates
modes.description: The word 'where' after a drug-interaction phrase about substrates, leading into 'minimal concentration changes'.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of VIZIMPRO with CYP2D6 substrates<< where>> minimal increases in concentration of the CYP

modes.label: Scattered small words
modes.description: Occasional short words in dosing or adverse-event text, such as 'persistent' or 'in'.
modes.example: Withhold gefitinib tablets for severe or<< persistent>> (up to 14 days)
